title.en: Amending Sections 1 and 2 of Republic Act No. 4169 to Include the Population Council of New York and Its Non-Filipino Staff as Recipient/Beneficiaries of Certain Exemptions and Privileges

text.en:
Section one of the Republic Act Numbered Four thousand one hundred sixty-nine, is hereby
further amended to include the Population Council of New York as recipient of the exemptions and privileges
provided in the said Section.

Section 2 of the same Act is hereby amended to include non-Filipino citizens serving on the staff
of the Population Council of New York as beneficiaries of the exemptions and privileges provided in the said

All laws, decrees, orders or regulations inconsistent with the provisions of this decree are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
